{"metadata":{"description":"Legacy name; moved to dsh-preview-media","id":"gh:1422886263","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-media-preview","slug":"439436269-ctrl/dsh-media-preview","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","media-player","video-preview"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Legacy name; moved to dsh-preview-media"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> **Renamed:** the canonical package is now `dsh-preview-media`. This repository is kept as the lega"},{"id":"p2s2","text":" the canonical package is now `dsh-preview-media`. This repository is kept as the legacy 0.1.x home."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-media-preview"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Video and audio preview for DeepSeek Harness: play `mp4`, `mov`, `mkv`, `webm` and `mp3`, `flac`, `w"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"av` right inside the right-Sidebar document preview instead of the built-in “this format cannot be p"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"reviewed” empty state."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**中文** | English (this file) · 中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The built-in preview registers renderers for text, code, Markdown, images, PDF, HTML, Office and spr"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"eadsheets, and lists video/audio suffixes as *known binary containers with no renderer* — so opening"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" a video shows an icon and one line of text. This plugin registers those suffixes and draws the brow"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ser's native player, fed by an authenticated streaming route that honours HTTP `Range`, so seeking w"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"orks and a 2 GB file is never loaded into memory or into the conversation."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then restart the desktop app (a profile patch change is read at boot). No configuration is required;"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" the defaults cover the common suffixes."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"To check it loaded, open any `.mp4` from the Files tab: the preview pane shows the player rather tha"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"n the unsupported-format notice."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Renderer** — registers two document-previews implementations, `dsh-media-preview/media` (video s"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"uffixes) and `dsh-media-preview/audio` (audio suffixes), with priority `extension`, `loading: 'rende"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"rer'`, and their suffixes declared binary so the “plain text” fallback is not offered.
- **Player** "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"— a native `<video>`/`<audio>` element with the browser's own controls. The video is fitted into the"},{"id":"p13s5","text":" pane with `object-fit: contain` inside a flexible frame, so a portrait or landscape clip is fully v"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"isible at once, with black letterboxing instead of spilling past the preview edge. Below it sit **倍速"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" / Speed** (cycles 1× → 1.25× → 1.5× → 1.75× → 2× → 0.5× → 0.75×), **循环 / Loop**, and — for video — "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"**全屏 / Full screen** and **画中画 / Picture in picture**. Speed and loop also apply to audio, and the c"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"hoice is remembered per browser. Audio shows a card with the file name, its size and the player. The"},{"id":"p13s10","text":" body reports `loaded` / `failed` back to the document preview owner so the tab's loading state sett"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"les.
- **Stream** — a Host route `GET|HEAD /api/media-preview?path=<absolute path>` that answers `20"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"0` with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `206` with `Content-Range` for one byte window, `416` with `Content-"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"Range: bytes */size` for an unsatisfiable window, and `HEAD` with headers only. It reads the file a "},{"id":"p13s14","text":"chunk at a time (`chunkBytes`, 1 MiB by default) through `ctx.fs.readByteRange`, so memory stays fla"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"t.
- **Desktop seeking** — the desktop app serves the page from `dsh-app://app` and proxies every re"},{"id":"p13s16","text":"quest through `protocol.handle`. Chromium's media stack cannot seek a response produced by a custom-"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"protocol handler (`video.seekable` collapses to `[0, 0]`), so in the desktop shell the player would "},{"id":"p13s18","text":"play but a dragged timeline would snap back to the start. The Host therefore also listens on an ephe"},{"id":"p13s19","text":"meral `127.0.0.1` port and hands the browser half a capability token (`GET /api/media-preview?discov"},{"id":"p13s20","text":"er=1`); in the shell the player streams from that loopback origin, where normal HTTP `Range` makes s"},{"id":"p13s21","text":"eeking work. In a plain browser the authenticated route is used as before.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Settings live on the `media-preview` entry (Settings → Plugins, or the profile patch). Every key has"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" a code-side default, so a partial config is valid."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Mount the route at all. _Off_ leaves the renderer registered but transfers no"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" bytes (`503`). |
| `routePath` | `/api/media-preview` | Route pathname. Must start with `/api/`; an"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ything else falls back to the default so the auth fence still applies. |
| `loopback` | `true` | Als"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"o serve bytes from the token-guarded `127.0.0.1` origin. This is what makes the desktop player seeka"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ble. _Off_ keeps only the authenticated route: the desktop shell can play but not seek. |
| `debug` "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"| `false` | Append playback/loopback diagnostics to `$DSH_HOME/media-preview-debug.log`. Leave off u"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"nless you are diagnosing a problem. |
| `maxBytes` | `2147483648` (2 GiB) | Largest file served; lar"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ger files answer `413`. |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read. |
| `videoExtensions` "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"| `mp4, m4v, mov, webm, ogv, ogg, mkv, avi, wmv, flv, 3gp, ts, m2ts, mts` | Suffixes the video playe"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"r claims. |
| `audioExtensions` | `mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, oga, opus, weba, wma, aiff, aif` | Suff"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ixes the audio player claims. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The browser half mirrors the suffix lists in `lib/client.js`; keep them in sync when changing either"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" side. The route path is published to the page as `__DSH_MEDIA_PREVIEW_CONFIG__` by the Host, so a c"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"onfigured path and the player's URL never drift apart."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Playback support"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Playback depends on the browser's own codecs, not on this plugin. Chromium/Electron plays MP4 (H.264"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"/AAC), WebM (VP8/VP9/Opus), Ogg and most audio formats. **Matroska (`.mkv`) and AVI usually do not d"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ecode** in Chromium; the player then reports “浏览器不支持这个编码 / This codec is not supported by the browse"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"r” and the _Open in app_ control in the preview header still hands the file to the system player. Re"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"muxing such files to MP4/WebM is the reliable fix."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it is built"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The browser half is a hand-written module-loader bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" })`) with `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` as its only module-table requests, so it needs no build s"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"tep and cannot drift from the Host's React copy."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- One byte window per request; a multi-range `Range` header is answered `416`. Browsers only ever as"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"k a media element for one window.
- `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.wmv`, `.flv` are claimed and listed, but Chrom"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ium cannot decode them; the plugin shows the player's error state rather than pretending they play.
"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"- No playlist, subtitle-track or speed controls of its own — the native controls own those.
- If a d"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"eployment blocks the loopback origin (firewall, policy), the player falls back to the authenticated "},{"id":"p25s6","text":"route automatically: the file still plays, but the desktop timeline is not seekable again. That is a"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"n Electron limitation (electron#38749, electron#51442), not something the route can fix."}],"truncated":true}
